Subject: [opensuse] Adobe flash player "no audio"

I am enrolled in a series of professional courses which are delivered as
Adobe Presentations.  My browser displays the graphic content just fine
(OpenSuse 10.3), but the adobe flash player plugin displays a message
"no audio" and there is no sound.  I've been through all the web
postings and faqs I can find and none of the solutions have worked. 
It's maddening for such a simple thing not to work.  All the adobe doc
says that sound works.
Does sound work for any of you?
wcn
